title: Brand Awareness Video — connection poster

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Pair an abstract promise with visible relationships so the words have a human referent.
strategic_value: The relaxed gathering can associate Cox connectivity with shared leisure.
demonstration: The supplied video poster places a white sentence fragment over people gathered beside an outdoor television. No temporal sequence is represented by this still.
practical_value: Judge whether the picture supplies the human meaning of the headline without requiring a technical product explanation.

content_islands.name: Social scene
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with people seated around a patio table, keeping the television in the upper right.

content_islands.name: Connection line
content_islands.spec: Place the large white line across the center of the gathering.
